messages:
Logan Wright: heads up: we found a real bug causing retry attempts to be double-counted in usage for one endpoint.

Logan Wright: scope looks limited to `/v1/rerank` (hosted api). if client retries (429/5xx) w/ same idempotency key, we currently emit metering events for BOTH attempts and downstream agg sums them.

Nadia Rahman: confirming. telemetry side: `metering.request_tokens` is emitted per attempt, and in `billing_agg_v2` we group by `request_id` not `idempotency_key`. so attempt=1 and attempt=2 become distinct rows and both get billed.

Cole Summers: oof. do we know how common retries are on rerank?

Mei Lin: quick query from yesterday 00:00-12:00 UTC: ~2.8% of rerank requests had >1 attempt (mostly bursty customers + a single region). median was 2 attempts, p99 was 4.

Emily Stone: this would explain a couple of the "invoice > console" deltas we saw where customer had lots of 429s. can we estimate $ exposure for Jan invoices?

Logan Wright: rough: in Jan, rerank retry-induced overcount looks like +0.6% of rerank units overall, but heavily skewed to ~6 accounts. highest single-account delta ~4.9% on rerank line item.

Allison Grant: adding context: we had a deploy window where rerank had elevated 429s due to capacity in us-east. so the retry rate spike aligns with that.

Cole Summers: what’s the intended billing behavior? only bill successful attempt? or bill all compute?

Nadia Rahman: current docs / finance expectation is bill only completed request (successful or user-visible failure), NOT internal retries that are auto-triggered by SDK or our gateway. we should treat retry attempts as non-billed unless it’s a user-initiated separate request.

Priya Natarajan: +1. let’s match the measurement language: bill for "processed request" not attempts. if our system retries, customer shouldn’t pay twice.

Logan Wright: proposed fix path:
1) add `request_outcome` + `retry_reason` dimensions at event source
2) in billing agg, bill only outcome in {"success","client_error"} and exclude outcome="retry"
3) dedupe on `idempotency_key` for rerank + keep attempt count for debugging

Nadia Rahman: I put up a draft PR that adds the dimensions + downstream wiring: https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/41917 (WIP). includes cardinality safeguards (retry_reason enum) so we don’t blow up the cube.

Cole Summers: nice. does that also solve the double counting immediately?

Nadia Rahman: not by itself. once dims land, we still need to update the invoice aggregator to filter out retry outcomes. I can add that in same PR or a follow-up. (leaning follow-up for safer rollback)

Emily Stone: pls keep finance in the loop on rollout timing. if this changes billed totals we need sign-off + decide whether to backfill / issue credits.

Allison Grant: also: alerts will fire as "negative delta" when we backfill corrected aggregates. we should suppress anomaly alerts during backfill windows.

Logan Wright: ack. I’ll coordinate w/ Allison on suppression rules + a runbook note.

Priya Natarajan: action items:
- Nadia: split PRs if needed; tag Cole + Logan for review
- Logan/Mei: pull Jan impacted accounts + quantify delta by account + endpoint
- Emily: let’s decide threshold for proactive credits vs wait for disputes

Mei Lin: I’ll post a sheet w/ impacted accounts + rerank retry deltas by EOD.

Cole Summers: reviewing PR now. quick note: could we carry `original_request_id` in attempts so dedupe logic is explicit? idempotency_key is sometimes missing on older SDKs.

Nadia Rahman: good call. we do have `client_request_id` on most traffic; for older SDKs, we can fallback to `(api_key, model, created_at minute bucket, input_hash)` but that’s sketchy. I’ll check coverage of idempotency_key vs client_request_id.

Logan Wright: for now, we can gate fix just to rerank where we see idempotency_key present >99%. let’s not invent fuzzy dedupe for billing.

Emily Stone: +1 pls don’t do fuzzy dedupe for invoices.

Allison Grant: FYI I added a note to the incident channel from last week; rerank 429s were already mitigated. so retry rate should be back to baseline.

Nadia Rahman: updated PR w/ `request_outcome` defaulting to "retry" for attempts where gateway returns `x-redwood-retry: true`. pinging for re-review.

Cole Summers: :thumbsup: looks good. please add a regression test w/ two attempts + same idempotency_key -> billed once.

Nadia Rahman: will do.

Logan Wright: thanks all. I’ll draft a short finance-facing summary (what happened / impact / fix / backfill plan) and drop in #finance once numbers are locked.

(Emily Stone reacted with :eyes:)

(Allison Grant reacted with :white_check_mark:)
